authority.duplicate_guard: read-only collision classification and treatment projection

inputs.work_key: optional explicit work identity; absence remains NONE
inputs.join_agent_id: optional advisory JOIN target; never executed by this tool

partition_proof.proof_id: required when proof object is supplied
partition_proof.disjoint_targets: at least two candidate future partition targets
partition_proof.shared_sinks: the exact current target-overlap reasons the proof claims to cover
partition_proof.evidence_refs: at least one public evidence reference

classifications.SELF_ACTIVE_CLAIM_CONFLICT: candidate agent already owns a different active board claim
classifications.DECLARED_JOIN_TARGET_INVALID: declared join target is not a relevant current conflict
classifications.DECLARED_JOIN: join treatment is relevant but remains unexecuted
classifications.INTENTIONAL_REPLICA: explicit REPLICA plus reason over an exact conflict; no independent-evidence standing
classifications.EXACT_DUPLICATE_HOLD: exact work-key or exact-task identity conflicts with active claimed work
classifications.SHARED_SINK_HOLD: target-only exact overlap requires sequencing/partition/join/pivot/replica treatment
classifications.PARTITION_PROOF_REQUIRED: caller supplied partition assertion is structurally incomplete or lacks evidence
classifications.PARTITION_CLEARS_TARGET_ONLY: structural evidence covers all target-only collision reasons; still HOLD until a new disjoint claim is committed
classifications.FUZZY_WARNING_ONLY: semantic token similarity without deterministic exact overlap; not a veto
classifications.CLEAR: no deterministic exact overlap and no fuzzy warning

treatments.PROCEED: eligible only on CLEAR or FUZZY_WARNING_ONLY; still no execution authority
treatments.JOIN: eligible on exact conflict; must be executed through athena_message_board action=join
treatments.PIVOT: eligible on holds/conflicts; requires selecting and claiming a non-conflicting residual
treatments.PARTITION: eligible only for target-only conflicts; exact task/work-key identity makes it ineligible even if structural target evidence exists
treatments.REPLICA: eligible on exact conflict only with explicit future/actual REPLICA intent and a non-empty reason

partition_semantics.commit_boundary: PARTITION_CLEARS_TARGET_ONLY remains HOLD_UNTIL_PARTITION_COMMITTED; this tool never creates the new disjoint board claim

mata_boundary.law: No SAME-WORK/SAME-BASE, OID/VID relation, portfolio relation, or canonical MATA work identity is fabricated from Message Board task prose

read_only_contract.same_fresh_head: when the checkout is already shared-current, guard evaluation leaves Git HEAD and Message Board bytes unchanged
read_only_contract.remote_sync: required shared freshness may fast-forward an otherwise clean behind checkout; that synchronization is not a board event or claim mutation

composition.existing_cohesion_runtime: passed into duplicate_guard(runtime, ...) rather than subclassed
composition.reason: compose with current/future CohesionMatchmakingRuntime guards, including the orthogonal evidence-coverage candidate, without competing inheritance
composition.sibling_candidate: PR #198 Cohesion evidence coverage touches the same AOR constructor seam but is semantically orthogonal; rebase/compose rather than overwrite

acceptance: exact work-key and exact task collisions hard-hold
incomplete partition evidence does not clear
valid structural target-only proof remains held until partition commit
partition cannot erase exact work-key/task identity
REPLICA requires reason and never claims independent evidence
declared JOIN must target a relevant conflict and remains unexecuted
self active incompatible claim is distinct
already-fresh guard call leaves board bytes and Git head unchanged
full Message Board/BOOT-MB/Party/Cohesion/repository regression suite passes
successor: After merge, project BOOT-MB DUPLICATE_WORK_HOLD through this guard so bootstrap can return structured treatment options without executing them
